briefdescription.para: Reads a table cell's raw text.

detaileddescription.para: Reads Id::rawText directly, instead of through jam::ConfigDocument::getTableValue(), which resolves through getAllSubText(). Both cell-construction paths the markdown parser's addTableCell() and the in-memory addCell() write Id::rawText unconditionally, so every cell carries it as its exact source text. getAllSubText() instead walks a cell's rendered child elements, which addCell() never adds; reading Id::rawText gives one reading that works for every manifest cell.

parameterdescription.para: The manifest document the row belongs to.
The table row holding the cell.
The identifier of the column to read.
